links.outcome: Over- and undertriage of AI self-triage versus NTS; urgency classification of patients with clinical sequelae
links.effect: Agreement none to slight (kappa 0.092). AI overtriaged 12.8% and undertriaged 5.4% versus NTS, but placed more patients with serious clinical sequelae into S1 and S2 than NTS did in U1 and U2.
links.quote: The AI triage programme overtriaged in 12.8% of cases and undertriaged in 5.4% compared with the NTS.

screen.reason: Prospective observational study comparing an AI self-triage tool completed by ED patients against standard physical triage (Dutch National Triage Standard).
